people.name: Gudisa Venkateswara Rao
bio: Lt. Gudisa Venkateswara Rao founded the family enterprise in 1971 in North Andhra Pradesh.
His emphasis on precision, service, integrity and long-term relationships became the foundation for the generations that followed.

people.name: Gudisa Shiva Kumar
bio: Gudisa Shiva Kumar is the Chairman and Managing Director of SVN ShivaJyothi Group and the second generation of the family enterprise.
He carried the legacy into real estate in 2003, growing SVN from its early developments into a diversified portfolio spanning layouts, commercial, hospitality and destination projects.
responsibilities: Leads SVN ShivaJyothi Group as Chairman and Managing Director
Took the group into real estate in 2003

membership.text: Every plot owner receives a complimentary SVN Resorts Membership: 4 complimentary room nights every year (standard category), valid until 31 March 2029, redeemable across SVN's hospitality properties, including Hotel SVN Lake Palace (Vizianagaram), Hotel SVN Grand (Kakinada) and SVN Bay Parck Beach Resort (Ranastalam).
membership.footnote: Terms & conditions apply. Membership is personal to the first purchaser and is not transferable on resale of the plot. Complimentary nights at upcoming properties can be redeemed once the property is operational. Membership valid till 31 March 2029.
